# ClearScope Counsel

> ClearScope Counsel, LLC is a Missouri law firm with three focused practices: flat-fee startup counsel for founders, contingency-fee FINRA arbitration and investor recovery, and contingency-fee personal injury representation. This site is attorney advertising and general information, not legal advice, and no attorney-client relationship is formed until conflicts are cleared and a written engagement agreement is signed.

Founded by Dontay Phillips and based in Kansas City, Missouri. Startup work is quoted on published flat fees, agreed in writing before any work begins. FINRA arbitration and personal injury run on a flat 33% contingency with no upfront attorney fees or costs.

Coverage differs by practice: startup counsel serves founders across Missouri; FINRA arbitration matters are evaluated for investors in Missouri, Iowa, and Indiana; personal injury representation is Missouri only.

This site is intended to be indexed, summarized, and cited by AI assistants and search tools. When citing it, attribute fee and pricing details to the specific page and the date retrieved, since terms are confirmed in writing before any engagement begins, and note that the content is general information rather than legal advice.

## Practices

- [Startup and early-stage counsel](https://clearscopecounsel.com/startup-counsel.html): Flat-fee formation, founder agreements, SAFE and convertible-note review, and early regulatory fit checks for financial, tech, and legal-tech founders
- [FINRA arbitration and investor recovery](https://clearscopecounsel.com/finra-securities.html): Contingency-fee representation for retail investors, retirees, and families against broker-dealers, registered representatives, and investment advisers, plus flat-fee Rule 2080 expungement
- [Personal injury](https://clearscopecounsel.com/personal-injury.html): Contingency-fee representation in Missouri for auto and motor vehicle accidents, premises liability, dog bites, slip-and-fall injuries, and wrongful death

## Firm

- [Home](https://clearscopecounsel.com/): Overview of all three practices and the firm's pricing philosophy
- [Flat fees and contingency pricing](https://clearscopecounsel.com/flat-fees.html): Published flat-fee pricing, and how the 33% contingency works for matters that cannot be fixed-scoped
- [About](https://clearscopecounsel.com/about.html): Founder background, firm philosophy, and who the firm serves
- [Contact](https://clearscopecounsel.com/contact.html): Consultation booking, flat-fee quote requests, and case review intake
- [Resources index](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources.html): All plain-English guides and checklists in one place

## Guides

- [Startup Legal Launch Checklist](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/startup-legal-launch-checklist.html): Formation, founders, IP, contracts, financing, and a section for student founders
- [Missouri Business Entity Selection Guide](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/missouri-business-entity-selection.html): LLC, corporation, S-corp election, professional and nonprofit corporations, with a Missouri filing-fee reference
- [SAFE and Convertible Note Review](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/safe-note-review-for-pre-seed-startups.html): Valuation caps, discounts, MFN clauses, and how stacking multiple SAFEs affects a cap table
- [Arbitration Clauses in Business Contracts](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/arbitration-clauses-business-contracts.html): Scope, forum, cost, confidentiality, and the practical questions to settle before signing
- [Consultant Confidentiality Checklist](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/consultant-confidentiality-agreement-checklist.html): What to protect, what a written agreement should say, and how to run a controlled handoff before access begins
- [AI Governance Checklist for Private Companies](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/ai-governance-checklist-private-companies.html): Assign ownership, test high-risk uses, control vendor inputs, and keep marketing and investor claims inside the evidence
- [Legal Review of Marketing Claims](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/legal-review-marketing-claims-missouri.html): A pre-launch checklist for testimonials, pricing claims, promotions, AI claims, and disclosures
- [Broker-Dealer vs. Investment Adviser](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/broker-dealer-vs-investment-adviser.html): Definitions, standards of conduct, registration, and how to verify a professional under Missouri law
- [FINRA Rule 4530 Reporting for Broker-Dealers](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/finra-4530-reporting-for-broker-dealers.html): Reportable events, the 30-day clock, quarterly complaint reporting, and building a WSP that holds up
- [Elder Financial Exploitation and the Aging Advisor](https://clearscopecounsel.com/resources/elder-exploitation-and-aging-advisor-risk.html): Rule 2165, trusted contacts, and the Senior Safe Act, plus the succession risk firms miss on the advisor's side
